Agricultural resilience.action: Refer for agricultural extension, improved inputs, cooperative market access, livestock services and climate-resilient production support.
Agricultural resilience.safeguard: Confirm that agriculture is an active livelihood before referral; do not assume agricultural work itself causes vulnerability.

Employment and enterprise.action: Assess for vocational training, job matching, apprenticeship, business formalisation, cooperative membership and market-linkage support.
Employment and enterprise.safeguard: Match assistance to the member's skills and employment goals. Do not automatically recommend debt.

Digital and financial inclusion.action: Offer digital-literacy support, safe mobile-money onboarding, device-access options and information about suitable regulated financial services.
Digital and financial inclusion.safeguard: Obtain consent and explain fees, privacy, fraud risks and complaint channels.

Education and skills.action: Assess for adult numeracy, literacy, TVET certification, digital-skills training and recognition of prior learning.
Education and skills.safeguard: Verify education history because missing survey information is not proof that a person lacks education.

Health-insurance inclusion.action: Refer uninsured members for eligibility assessment and supported enrolment in an appropriate health-insurance programme.
Health-insurance inclusion.safeguard: Verify current coverage before taking action because coverage may have changed since the survey.

Social protection and basic services.action: Prioritise a caseworker assessment covering social protection, housing quality, overcrowding, water, sanitation and household-care burdens.
Social protection and basic services.safeguard: Require human review. The prediction must never be the sole basis for denying or withdrawing assistance.
